products.name: SIRUI Traveler 5C Carbon Fiber Tripod
products.summary: The 5C folds to 13 in (33 cm) and weighs 1.87 lb with its ball head, the shortest full-height tripod in this group, so it lies flat in most roller-bag compartments and daypacks. It reaches 54.3 in with the column up, enough for chest height or a bit above.
products.renterNote: Mirrorless shooters with a 24-70mm or small telephoto who want a full-height tripod inside a carry-on or daypack; the caveats are a basic single-knob ball head and a light build that moves in wind unless you hang a bag from the hook.
pros: Folds to 13 in (33 cm) at 1.87 lb (0.85 kg), the most compact full-size tripod on this list
54.3 in (138 cm) max height, 6.3 in min height, 5 sections with twist locks
Ships with a carry bag and stays under 2 lb with the head
cons: Stock 3T-35K ball head has a single friction and lock knob and no separate pan, and some owners swap it
Light and thin-legged, so it shakes in wind and with telephoto lenses unless you hang weight from the center hook
facts: Weight 0.85 kg / 1.87 lb, carbon fiber (maker table)
Max height 1380 mm / 54.3 in; retracted (column down) height 615 mm / 24.2 in; min height 160 mm / 6.3 in
Max load 4 kg / 8.8 lb; 5 leg sections; tube diameter 10-22 mm
Reverse-fold legs, twist leg locks, 3 leg angles 23/52/84 degrees (First Quadcopter)
Ball head 3T-35K, 25 mm ball, 4 kg load (First Quadcopter); 6-year warranty (First Quadcopter)

specs.Head: 3T-35K ball head with Arca-style quick-release plate

products.carryOnFit: At 13 in / 33 cm folded it is shorter than most carry-on roller dimensions and fits a daypack or the long side of a cabin bag; airline carry-on size and what counts as a personal item vary, so check your airline.
products.scoreNote: 13 in fold and 1.87 lb are the best portability numbers here and 54.3 in is usable; a light 8.8 lb rating, a basic stock head and wind shake keep stability at 6.

products.name: Peak Design Travel Tripod (Carbon Fiber)
products.query: Peak Design Travel Tripod Carbon Fiber
products.matchName: Peak Design Travel Tripod Carbon Fiber
products.summary: Peak Design packs the whole tripod, ball head included, to the diameter of a water bottle at 15.5 in (39 cm) and 2.8 lb, yet reaches 60 in and carries 20 lb. It is the one here that takes a full-frame body with a telephoto and still goes in a cabin bag.
products.renterNote: Travelers flying carry-on with a full-frame body and a 70-200mm or longer zoom who want one compact tripod with its head built in; the caveats are the premium price, no separate pan on the ball head and cast leg-lock latches a few owners report breaking.
pros: Folds to 15.5 in (39 cm) at 2.8 lb (1.3 kg) with the head built in, roughly as thick as a water bottle
60 in max height (about 53 in with the center column down per a B&H answer) and 20 lb rated load
Reversible center column, weight hook and a stowable phone mount in the column
cons: Ball head has one adjustment ring and no separate pan, so panoramas and video panning need an add-on
At least one owner reports a cast leg-lock latch snapping and others a plastic piece breaking
Costs several times what the SIRUI 5C does
facts: Weight 2.8 lb / 1.3 kg, carbon fiber (B&H; Golden Lens lists 2.81 lb)
Max height 60 in; min height 5.5 in; about 53 in without the center column extended (B&H Q&A)
Load capacity 20 lb / 9.1 kg, optimized for full-frame DSLRs with telephoto lenses (maker)
5 leg sections, aluminum leg cams, integrated ball head with Peak Design and Arca-type compatible plate, hex wrenches and soft case included (B&H)

specs.Head: Built-in ball head, single adjustment ring, Arca-type compatible plate

products.carryOnFit: At 15.5 in / 39 cm folded it clears the long side of typical cabin bags and fits a backpack water-bottle pocket (Pack Hacker, Golden Lens); airline carry-on size varies, so check your airline.
products.scoreNote: 20 lb rating, 60 in height and a 15.5 in fold at 2.8 lb are class-leading together; the premium price, no independent pan and reports of snapped leg-lock latches limit build and value.

products.name: Manfrotto PIXI EVO 2-Section Mini Tripod
products.query: Manfrotto PIXI EVO 2-Section Mini Tripod MTPIXIEVO-BK
products.badge: Best mini for a personal item
products.summary: At 8.07 in (20.5 cm) closed and 0.57 lb, the PIXI EVO is small enough for a jacket pocket or camera-bag side pocket, so it never competes with your carry-on for space. It is a tabletop and low-angle support that stands 7.87 in tall, not an eye-level tripod.
products.renterNote: Carry-on travelers with a compact mirrorless body and a small zoom who want a tabletop or low-angle tripod that fits in a pocket; it will not reach eye level, and owners report it is too springy for heavy kits.
pros: 8.07 in (20.5 cm) closed and 0.57 lb (0.26 kg), small enough for a jacket or bag side pocket
5.51 lb (2.5 kg) payload and two leg angles with a 90-degree portrait notch in the ball head
Pack Hacker used it with a Fuji X-T3 and 55-200mm lens without trouble
cons: Only 7.87 in (20 cm) tall at full extension, so it needs a table, railing or bench for most shots
Owners report flex at the ball-head post with heavier kits and image shake when the camera is touched without a remote or timer
facts: Maximum height 20 cm / 7.87 in (maker); 2.4 in min height (B&H)
2 leg sections, 5.51 lb (2.5 kg) safety payload (maker; Markertek)
Material aluminum and technopolymer; 1/4-20 screw mount; no quick-release plate included (B&H Q&A)
products.carryOnFit: At 8.07 in / 20.5 cm closed it fits in a jacket pocket or any bag; it is far below any airline carry-on or personal-item limit, but check your airline for security-screening rules.
products.scoreNote: A pocket-size 8.07 in fold at 0.57 lb earns a 10 for portability, but 7.87 in of height and flex under heavy kits hold stability and height down.

this tripod is solid and perfect for mirrorless cameras!
